item.title: fix(telegram): make ask_user controls native and reliable (#130262)
item.summary: fix(telegram): make ask_user controls native and reliable (#130262) Make ask_user use native Telegram controls when one single-select question can be represented directly, while keeping multi-select and batch questions on the text fallback. Add native Other-to-ForceReply input, preserve Gateway-owned option ordering across Telegram, Slack, and Discord, and prevent later progress from overwriting the delivered question. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
